import math, heapq, random, itertools, re, html
from pathlib import Path
from collections import deque, Counter
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
from fractions import Fraction

def cinema(s):
    v = iter(map(int, s.split()))
    out = []
    for _ in range(next(v)):
        (m, p, q) = (next(v), next(v), next(v))
        if m == 0 or (q - p - m) * -m <= 0:
            out.append('0')
            continue
        total = math.comb(p + q, p)
        r = p + m
        out.append(str(total - (math.comb(p + q, r) if 0 <= r <= p + q else 0)))
    return '\n'.join(out)
